text:
you are good enough and you are not alone. 🪷🔆🙏 A learn blockage is something very common.

I always wonder that the phone hotlines in the country are all in hebrew, arabic and russian...but not in english (or maximum to the second "kishu").
 70 % of the phone operators refuse to speak english or realy do not.
That costs a lot of time in waiting lines.
Other than that I am fine with my humble hebrew skills
For texts and posts AI is doimg a great job.

I gave up on Duolingo. Its a nice game but don't guide you to speak.
I am too old for Ulpan ;)
New apps like jumpspeak are efficient but do not offer hebrew..
